newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia's QTC moving A$ issue to tap from tender.
newsitem.headline: Australia's QTC moving A$ issue to tap from tender.

text.p: Queensland Treasury Corp (QTC) said on Monday that to ensure that its domestic primary issuance in Australian dollars is consistent with current market dealing practice, issuance will move to tap from tender.
QTC said it is envisaged that commencing May, and subject to borrowing requirements, that Queensland's borrowing arm will tap A$80 million to A$100 million per month to its Global Distribution Group.
Previously QTC had held domestic bond tenders every four to six weeks.
However, tenders will be conducted when tap issuance is considered inappropriate, such as the issue of larger volumes or the creation of new lines of stock, it said.

An update of QTC's borrowing estimate and funding sources for 1997/98 will be provided in July, and to keep investors informed, QTC said its bonds on issue and the amount tapped during the month will be updated on a weekly basis.
